title: Near-linear cycles in connected vertex-transitive graphs
summary: A Lean formalization of the near-linear cycle theorem in "Lovász conjecture holds asymptotically". For every positive ε, sufficiently large connected finite vertex-transitive graphs contain a simple cycle with at least n^(1−ε) edges. The development includes a weaker-constant Bondy–Locke path-to-cycle comparison and the finite approximate-group and expansion arguments used in the path proofs.
